description: This file defines classes and functions for fetching, transforming, and validating OECD unemployment data, including query parameter validation and data extraction from OECD endpoints.

classes.name: OECDUnemploymentQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for OECD unemployment data, including country, sex, age, and seasonal adjustment, with validation logic.

classes.name: OECDUnemploymentData
classes.description: Data model for OECD unemployment data.

classes.name: OECDUnemploymentFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class that transforms queries, extracts data from OECD endpoints, and transforms raw data into data models.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a validated OECDUnemploymentQueryParams object, setting default start and end dates.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Fetches raw unemployment data from OECD API, processes CSV response, and returns list of records.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw data dictionaries into OECDUnemploymentData model instances.
